## Rust Mite Swarm (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
N Fine vermin (swarm)  
**Init** +2; **Senses** scent metals 90 ft.; Perception +0  

**Defense**

 **AC** 20, touch 20, flat-footed 18 (+8 size, +2 Dex)  
**hp** 88 (11d8)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +5, **Will** +3  
**Immune** swarm traits, weapon damage  

**Offense**

 **Speed** fly 30 ft. (poor)  
**Melee** swarm (2d6 plus quick rust)  
**Special Attacks** quick rust, distraction (DC 15)  

**Tactics**

 **During Combat** The swarm heads toward the nearest metal object.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 1, **Dex** 15, **Con** 10, Int—, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 2  
**Base Atk** +8; CMB—; CMD—  
**Skills** Fly +12  

**Special Abilities**

 **Quick Rust (Ex)** Any metal object in a fiendish rust mite swarm is destroyed. Masterwork and magic items that fail a DC 17 Reflex save gain the broken condition (destroyed on a second failed save). The DC for this ability is Dexterity-based.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any (cold, mountains, underground)  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or rust field (3-10)  
**Treasure** none
